scope_note: This records Titchener's 1912 methodological rule for descriptive introspection; it does not endorse the rule as valid for contemporary psychological measurement.
statement: Titchener's stimulus error occurred when an observer attended to the stimulus instead of the sensation.
statement_zh: 依 Titchener 的定義，觀察者注意刺激物而非感覺時，就犯了刺激錯誤。
